component.name: Montage
component.summary: Edit video on a multitrack timeline

description.p: Montage is a non-linear video editor for creators and editors. It works offline with your files and needs no account.

ul.li: Multitrack timeline with insert, overwrite, ripple, roll, slip, slide and razor edits
Transitions, keyframes on every parameter, picture in picture and blend modes
Colour correction in linear light, colour wheels, curves, LUTs, scopes and HDR
Chroma key, masks with tracking and a stabilizer
Titles, templates, rolling credits and captions with SRT and WebVTT
Mixer with buses, automation, equalizer, compressor, noise reduction and loudness normalisation
Multicamera editing, audio sync, scene detection and editing by transcript
Export queue with web, social and master presets, chapters and hardware encoding
OpenTimelineIO, EDL, Final Cut Pro XML, FCPXML, AAF and Premiere project import
